name: tree
need: Show a hierarchy that opens and closes: folders, groups, nested records; pick one or check many

--ds-tree-row-height.description: a `.ds-tree` row: the base height (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to

--ds-tree-padding.description: the side padding of a tree row, 2px per density step

--ds-tree-indent.description: how far each level of a tree sits in, 4px per size step

--ds-tree-toggle-size.description: the chevron's box at the start of a folder's row (a leaf keeps its room), 4px per size step

--ds-tree-radius.description: the corners of a tree row (times `--ds-shape`)

--ds-tree-selected-bg.description: the chosen row of a tree (`aria-selected="true"`)

--ds-tree-guide.description: the hairline that runs down a folder's children, below its chevron

--ds-tree-drop-color.description: the line or frame that marks where a dragged item would drop

rotate..ds-tree__toggle > svg: a disclosure chevron: the folder's chevron turns a quarter on the spring as it opens

height..ds-tree__group: a folder's children open to auto on --ds-ease-out, as .ds-collapsible (D29), only where interpolate-size exists
height..ds-tree__item[aria-expanded=\"false\"]: a folder's children close (0) on --ds-ease-in, as .ds-collapsible, only where interpolate-size exists
